title: Price Comparison
description: Parallel search across Amazon & BestBuy with structured reports.
prompt:
Task: Compare [Product Name] across Amazon and BestBuy.
Steps:
1. IMPORTANT: Call 'delegate_sub_task' twice simultaneously in your FIRST response—one for Amazon and one for BestBuy.
2. In each site, find the top 3 matching items.
3. Extract: Full Name, Price, Rating, and Shipping Details.
4. Present the findings in a Markdown table for easy comparison.
5. Highlight the 'Best Value' choice based on price and rating.

title: Deep Market Research
description: Synthesize findings from 3+ sources with citations.
prompt:
Task: Conduct a deep dive into [Industry/Topic].
Requirements:
1. Use Google Search to identify at least 3 high-authority sources (docs, news, or reports).
2. Navigate to each source and extract key information regarding trends, statistics, and major players.
3. Synthesize the findings into an Executive Summary.
4. Provide a detailed breakdown of findings with clickable Source URLs for every claim.
5. End with 3-5 'Future Outlook' bullet points.

title: Feature implementation
description: Autonomous coding with aesthetic and architectural consistency.
prompt:
Task: Implement a new [Feature/Component] in the current project.
Execution Protocol:
1. First, use search_web or list_dir to find existing components and design patterns.
2. Read 1-2 relevant files to understand the project's coding style and dependencies.
3. Plan the implementation: outline where the new files will go and what changes are needed in existing files.
4. Create/Edit the files using appropriate filesystem tools.
5. Ensure the UI follows premium aesthetics: use gradients, modern typography (Inter), and smooth hover effects.

title: Form & Admin Help
description: Handle complex official forms and CAPTCHA scenarios.
prompt:
Task: Assist in filling a form at [URL] for [Action].
Protocol:
1. Navigate to the page and identify all required fields.
2. If I have provided the data, fill the fields using the 'fill' or 'type' tools.
3. If a field is ambiguous, ask me before proceeding.
4. If a CAPTCHA or error message appears, take a screenshot, use vision to analyze it, and attempt to resolve it.
5. Stop at the final 'Submit' button and ask for my confirmation to finish.

title: Parallel Site Scan
description: Multi-site headline extraction using parallel sub-agents.
prompt:
Task: Scan multiple sites for news on [Topic].
Sites: [Site 1], [Site 2], [Site 3]
Instructions:
1. Trigger 3 independent sub-agents simultaneously, one for each site.
2. Each sub-agent must extract the top 2 headline titles and their respective URLs.
3. Once sub-agents return, consolidate all findings into a single, clean list categorized by source.
4. Ensure no duplicate news items are included in the final report.

title: SOP & Preferences
description: Teach the agent your workflows, tech stack, and favorite tools.
prompt:
Task: Store my development preferences for [Project/Technology].
Details:
1. I strictly use [Stack Name, e.g., TypeScript & Tailwind].
2. I prefer [Coding Style, e.g., Functional Components with Hooks].
3. Use 'memory_create_entity' to store this as a 'user_preference' or 'project_sop'.
4. For all future tasks involving this project, search my memory first to ensure compliance with these rules.
5. Confirm once the preferences have been successfully indexed.

title: Discovery & Extract
description: Explore navigation trees and extract structured datasets.
prompt:
Task: Discover and extract [Data Type, e.g., Laptop Specs] from [Website].
Exploration Strategy:
1. Navigate to the main listing page.
2. Use 'get_interactive_elements' to identify filtering sidebar or sorting options.
3. Apply filters for [Criteria, e.g., Price > $1000].
4. Extract a structured dataset for the top 5 results: Name, Price, Rating, and a summary of key features.
5. Report the data in a clean CSV-like Markdown format.

title: Ultimate Trip Planner
description: Multi-step orchestration for flights, hotels, and activities.
prompt:
Task: Plan a comprehensive 3-day trip to [Destination].
Plan Outline:
1. Search for flight options for [Dates] and find the top 3 based on 'Shortest Duration' and 'Lowest Price'.
2. Search for hotels in [Preferred Area] with at least a 4-star rating.
3. Identify 3 'must-visit' tourist attractions or local activities.
4. Create a daily itinerary (Day 1, 2, 3) combining these flights, hotels, and sights.
5. Provide a rough total budget estimate for the trip.
